## English

Fix the Win32 trend-chart hover flicker by double-buffering the GDI+ draw.

- The trend chart painted straight to the visible HDC, so every column change
  repainted the whole chart in visible stages — heavy flicker on the Win32 build
  (the Tk build was already smooth).
- It is now composed on an offscreen memory bitmap and blitted in a single
  `BitBlt`, the same pixmap-then-Blit path the Tk build uses.
- No geometry change: `rc.Left`/`rc.Top` are 0 for an owner-drawn control, so
  local drawing lands in exactly the same place. Falls back to direct drawing if
  the offscreen bitmap cannot be allocated.

## 中文

修复 Win32 趋势图悬停闪烁：GDI+ 绘制改为离屏双缓冲。

- 此前趋势图直接画到可见 HDC，每次切换列都要分多步重绘整张图，Win32 版因此严重闪烁（Tk 版本身已是平滑的）。
- 现在先画到离屏内存 bitmap，再用一次 `BitBlt` 上屏，与 Tk 版所用的 pixmap→Blit 路径一致。
- 几何完全不变：owner-draw 控件的 `rc.Left`/`rc.Top` 为 0，局部坐标落点与原位置相同。离屏 bitmap 分配失败时回退为直绘，不会丢失控件。
